step.actions:
Unauthenticated Resources:

a. Get below URI:
- Version: /redfish
- Service Root: /redfish/v1/
- Redfish metadata document: /redfish/v1/$metadata
- OData service document: /redfish/v1/odata
- OpenAPI YAML document:  /redfish/v1/openapi.yaml (Not support yet)
step.expectedresults: a. Redfish shall not require password.

step.actions:
Authentication:

a. Power on DUT and boot to OS.
b. Connect with remote PC by LAN.
c. Execute browser on remote PC and link to below address:
 https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1
d. Execute browser on remote PC and link to below address:
 https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1/Systems
e. Login:
 Account: administrator
 Password: advantech
step.expectedresults:
c. The Redfish service root shall not need password.
e. It shall be able to login Redfish and get response.

step.actions:
Login Fail:

a. Clear cookie on remote PC.
b. Get below URI:
#/redfish/v1/Systems/0
c. Press "Cancel" button when user/password required.
d. Check response message.
step.expectedresults:
d1. Status code shall be 401 (Unauthorized).
d2. Redfish shall reply error extend message as below:
"Required header 'Authorization or X-Auth-Token' is missing in the request."

step.actions:
a. Download latest version of Redfish Service Validator (RSV).
b. Follow DMTF step to install RSV on remote PC.
c. Power on DUT and boot to OS.
d. Connect DUT with remote PC by LAN (MGMT port).
e. Execute Redfish Validator on remote PC.
f. Edit config file for test environment.
g. Start the test and waiting test result.
h. After test finished, check test log.
step.expectedresults: h. Test result shall not have any fail item.

step.actions:
a. Send below command Talend API Tester:
- Select "Head" method.
- Fill in URI: /redfish/v1
b. Check response data
step.expectedresults:
b1. Redfish shall support "Head" method.
b2. Redfish shall not return message body information.
b3. Redfish shall reply "Link" in header.

"ExpandQuery": {

/redfish/v1/Managers/0/LogServices/Log/Entries?$top=5
d. Check response data.
step.expectedresults:
d1. Status code shall 200.
d2. Redfish shall return 1 ~ 5 SEL entries.

step.actions:
Get Resource:

a. Send below URI with "Get" operation and check status code:
a1. #curl -k -v --header 'If-Match: "5a709faf54bea895958b"' -X GET "https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1"
a2. #curl -k -v --header 'If-Match: "4a709faf54bea895958b"' -X GET "https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1"
a3. #curl -k -v --header 'If-None-Match: "5a709faf54bea895958b"' -X GET "https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1"
a4. #curl -k -v --header 'If-None-Match: "4a709faf54bea895958b"' -X GET "https://<BMC IP>/redfish/v1"
step.expectedresults:
a1. Status Code shall be 200 and Redfish shall reply Service Root.
a2. Status Code shall be 412 and Redfish shall reply error response.
a3. Status Code shall be 304 and Redfish shall reply empty response.
a4. Status Code shall be 200 and Redfish shall reply Service root.

step.actions:
Patch Resource

a. Get below URI to check ETag:
/redfish/v1/AccountService/Accounts/5
b. Copy Etag that reply by Redfish in header.
c. On Talend API Tester, select patch method
d. Target URI is /redfish/v1/AccountService/Accounts/5
e. Add header "Content-Type", value is "application/json".
f. Add header "If-Match", value is modified Etag.
g. Below is body:
{
  "UserName": "admin1",
  "Password": "admin1"
}
h. Press send button and check Redfish response.
i. Modify "If-Match" header value to original Etag.
j. Press send button again and check Redfish response.
step.expectedresults:
h. Status code shall be 412 and patch shall be failed.
j1. Status code shall be 200 and patch shall be successful.
j2. Redfish shall reply new Etag.

step.actions:
Patch Resource with Incorrect Header:

a. Follow step 2 to test this case but use "If-None-Match" header instead of "If-Match" header.
step.expectedresults: a. Status code shall be 428 and patch shall be failed.

step.expectedresults:
b1. Status code shall be 400 (Bad Request).

step.actions:
Get Fail 400 (QueryCombinationInvalid):

a. Get URI:
/redfish/v1/Managers/0/LogServices/Log/Entries/1?$top=3&only
b. Check response data.
step.expectedresults:
b1. Status code shall be 400 (Bad Request).
b2. Redfish shall reply 2 error message and error extend message as below:
- Message 1: The format of the query parameter request $top=3&only is wrong. General format is url followed by ?$query1=value1&$query2=value2&.., or ?only or ?excerpt"
- Message 2: "Two or more query parameters in the request cannot be used together."
- Message 3: "A general error has occurred. See ExtendedInfo for more information."
